test_open_bookmarks_panel.title: Verify bookmarks panel opens when clicking the dots icon.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Views and enter fullscreen mode on a camera view
steps.expected: Camera view is displayed in fullscreen

steps.action: Locate the bookmarks toggle or dots icon in the fullscreen overlay
steps.expected: Bookmarks toggle control is visible in fullscreen

steps.action: Click the bookmarks toggle
steps.expected: Bookmark panel opens within the fullscreen view

steps.action: Verify the bookmark panel displays saved bookmarks
steps.expected: Bookmarks list is visible and populated (or shows empty state)

steps.action: Toggle the bookmarks panel closed
steps.expected: Bookmark panel closes, returning to the fullscreen camera view

test_delete_bookmark.title: Verify a bookmark can be deleted with confirmation.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Channels - Integrations
steps.expected: Channels - Integrations page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the delete confirmation popup to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: delete confirmation popup is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target delete confirmation popup
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the delete confirmation popup

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the delete confirmation popup no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: delete confirmation popup is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted delete confirmation popup does not reappear after refresh
